_metadata.description: Repeatable health snapshots for internet and local network quality.

requirements.title: Network health snapshots capture comparable quality metrics
requirements.description: The scenario shall produce a repeatable health snapshot that includes gateway reachability, WAN reachability, DNS latency, resolver behavior, IPv4/IPv6 status, packet loss, jitter, throughput, and local host/network facts with timestamps and measurement confidence.

validation.notes: Add API and domain tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-001] that run deterministic probe fakes and verify the snapshot report schema and confidence flags.
